Claim-bearing sentences are exact EvidenceClaim bodies registered in paper/evidence/claims.json; the numerical-screening gate in paper/evidence/result-gates.json names the typed manifest that admits the section and records the outcome as accepted screening, preregistered null or recorded characterization without opening any physics level.
